setup.text: A dark screen asks which colour the creator should choose. Two labelled options appear side by side: A, Red and B, Blue. Viewers may choose before seeing the outcome. The neutral overlay does not reveal either option's vote count.

reveal.text: The creator's recorded choice is B, Blue. The Blue option is highlighted and a short tone sounds. This is the actual recorded outcome; a later viewer's choice does not change it.

humanReview.method: Actual application revision 3 setup/reveal played fully twice with captions showing and audio unmuted; both text descriptions expanded.
